newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MPC taps loan to buy more Bonifacio shares.
newsitem.headline: MPC taps loan to buy more Bonifacio shares.

text.p: Philippine holding firm Metro Pacific Corp (MPC) said on Tuesday it had borrowed $200 million to pay for an additional 16 percent stake in Bonifacio Land Corp.

"Metro Pacific has arranged a $200 million syndicated loan bridge facility led by ING Bank, Manila, the take-out for which will be a combination of debt, quasi-debt and equity within the next 12 months," MPC president Napoleon Nazareno said in a statement.
MPC officials declined to give details of the bridge loan.
MPC used the loan proceeds to pay Filinvest Development Corp and Filinvest Land Inc for their stakes in Bonifacio Land, a 17-member consortium organised by MPC two years ago.
MPC now owns 56 percent of Bonifacio Land, which holds 55 percent of Fort Bonifacio Development Corp, developer of a 214-hectare lot at the edge of the Manila's Makati business district.
